# NestLine Automation

> AI consulting agency based in Montreal, Quebec. We build done-for-you AI systems — lead capture, voice AI receptionists, customer service chatbots, internal knowledge bases, and full business automation — for small and mid-sized businesses across Quebec and Canada.

NestLine serves contractors, real estate agents, financial advisors, and other service businesses. We also build custom websites and manage Google/Meta ad campaigns. Every AI engagement includes a one-time setup fee plus a monthly retainer covering hosting, monitoring, and ongoing improvements.

## Services

- [AI Consulting](https://nestlineautomation.ca/en/ai-consulting): Done-for-you AI systems — lead capture & follow-up agents, customer service chatbots, internal knowledge base (RAG) agents, voice AI receptionists, document processing, appointment booking, and full business automation. Custom-quoted after a free discovery call; initial build often takes 2–5 days once access and inputs are available, though testing, revisions, and approval can extend the total timeline.
- [Website Design](https://nestlineautomation.ca/en/websites): Custom, mobile-responsive websites built to convert, automation-ready from day one. Starting from $1,500 setup + $150/month.
- [Ads Management](https://nestlineautomation.ca/en/ads): Google and Meta ad campaign management with full transparency and no hidden fees.
